cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. That flat-pack cupboard's leaning. I could take a look.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Wonderful. Which page explains that leftover door?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold it for a second?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Just to clarify: you're asking for my help?

mechanism: A makes admitting dependence the condition for granting the superior's help with assembly.
confusable: A generic commanding preface is not enough; questions about help must be treated as requests A has authority to approve.
comparison: Physical assembly pressure contrasts with the other alternative's discreet backstage rescue.
seedUse: Canonical S01 seeds supply approval-framed superiority; D01-a supplies assembly and an explicit help request. D01-b provides contrast through reluctance to admit need.
